title: Nebula Solo #035 (에메랄드 성운 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 인종 Indian · 메이크업 글래스 스킨 5단계 · 극한 · 배경 호텔 로비 · 힐 숫자 없음 · 몸 주얼리)

Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, blunt bob chocolate brown hair — full body glowing emerald nebula starfield fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid starfield body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, a deep cosmos of swirling luminous gas clouds and dust lanes in rich overlapping layers, thousands of tiny bright stars embedded across every curve, a few large brilliant stars with soft cross-shaped glints, thin glowing constellation lines linking the brightest stars across her torso and legs, glowing softly from within, nothing lying flat. Dense cosmic surface — BLAZING deep emerald-green and sapphire-blue nebula clouds across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID tiny white and pale-gold stars and thin pale-gold constellation lines linking the brightest stars, softly glowing, completely opaque, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of the same glowing nebula starfield, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.

Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the starfield figure — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-bright glass skin dripping with wet liquid shine, blinding liquid highlighter across the cheekbones, nose bridge, forehead and chin, a flushed dewy blush, mirror-gloss lips.

Background: a bright luxury hotel lobby with a polished pale marble floor, a standard-height entrance door, a curved staircase and a long reception counter, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
